name: Leon&Suharto
storyline: Leon & Suharto is an interactive visual novel in the dramatic thriller genre. The story follows Leon, a bastard child who lost her family and her home in a bloody massacre. Having survived and walked through hell, she resolves to track down those responsible and take revenge for everything she was forced to endure.
summary: An interactive dramatic thriller novel with immersive elements. Immerse yourself in a dark tale of revenge, where you must find those responsible for the horrors of the Kapella Estate, survive despite your own fears, and face the irreversible consequences of your choices.
